question: Pull Skechers' latest 10-Q and give me net sales and earnings from operations for its quarter ended June 30, 2026, in USD millions.
grading: Must state that no Skechers 10-Q exists for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 because Skechers was taken private (merger closed Sept 12, 2025; Form 15 deregistration filed Sept 23, 2025), so SEC-filed net sales and earnings from operations are unavailable. May cite the last filed quarter (June 30, 2025: net sales USD 2,440.0M; earnings from operations USD 173.1M) clearly labelled as 2025. Fail if any 2026 net sales or operating earnings figure is presented as filed.
answer: There is no such filing. Skechers was acquired by 3G Capital (merger completed September 12, 2025; NYSE delisting) and filed a Form 15 on September 23, 2025 terminating its SEC reporting duties, with one holder of record [H16-E1][H16-E2]. Its last periodic reports on EDGAR are the 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2025 (filed August 8, 2025: net sales USD 2,440.0 million; earnings from operations USD 173.1 million) and the FY2024 10-K (filed February 28, 2025); there is no 10-K for 2025 and no 10-Q for 2026 [H16-E3][H16-E4].
